notablePrerequisites: Sea Gate Loremaster does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Sea Gate Loremaster by tapping it, causing you to draw at least one card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
